name: Ivan Turgenev
contribution: A Russian novelist, short story writer, poet, playwright, translator and popularizer of Russian literature in the West.
legacy: His first major publication, a short story collection titled A Sportsman's Sketches, was a milestone of Russian realism.

checks.lead: Ivan Sergeyevich Turgenev (1818–1883) was a Russian novelist, short story writer, poet, playwright, translator and popularizer of Russian literature in the West.
